Priya R: Heads-up — handing off weekend coverage for ZenithHealth contract readiness. They go live Tue 2026-03-24 with 99.95% SLA for inference latency (p95 < 450ms). We have a scheduled load test Sun 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC. Need oncall to watch capacity, pre-warm caches, and validate fallbacks.

Alex M: Copy. Anything specific I should watch for? p95 crossing threshold or queueing? :eyes:

Priya R: Primary risk is bursty concurrent sessions replaying long contexts (seq_len ~2048) hitting model v2-big. That combo increases decode time and KV-cache pressure. If p95 > 450ms, fallback rule should route to v2-medium-quantized. Also watch GPU run queue length and OOMs.

Matt G: Suggest pre-warming KV caches and bumping the dedicated pool from 4 -> 6 GPUs for the 90m window. Contract covers temporary capacity. Priya, confirm pool id & region so infra can approve.

Priya R: Region: us-west1-dedicated-zenith. Pool id: zenith-pool-1. Model SKU currently: gpt-infer-v2-big (fp16). I'll submit the capacity request now and add a canary policy (5% -> v2-small) to catch regressions.

Alex M: Runbook items for oncall: monitor p95, tail latency, error rate, and queue_len. Alerts to trigger: p95 > 600ms OR queue_len > 16 OR inference error rate > 0.05%. If triggered, execute evacuation to v2-small cluster and enable autoscale-burst.

dev_oncall_bot: Reminder: Scheduled load test — ZenithHealth — Sun 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC. Watch channel #eng-oncall.

Priya R: Quick commands if you need to validate pool size / scale:
```
# list zenith pools
rdwctl pools list --region us-west1 | grep zenith
# scale pool
rdwctl pools scale --id zenith-pool-1 --replicas 6
# check model routes
rdwctl routes get --project zenith | jq '.'
```

Sarah CS: From CS: Zenith will replay ~60m of production traffic starting 02:00 UTC. They may run two overlapping sessions. They accepted the canary plan. Contractually we're at <0.05% errors and need to keep p95 under 450ms. CS will notify us if they see errors on their side.

Matt G: I'll be oncall starting 2026-03-21 18:00 UTC through 2026-03-23 06:00 UTC and will monitor the scale-up. Alex, can you take the overnight slice 00:00-08:00 UTC on 03/22?

Alex M: I can take 00:00-08:00 UTC on 03/22. Adding myself to rota and will watch dashboards. :thumbsup:

Priya R: Thanks — added concise notes to the runbook (link pinned in channel). If anyone changes pool scaling or routing, please post the command and tag @Priya R in this thread. Leaving the oncall to you two. Good luck and ping if anything odd. :rocket:
